title: ZKGames
tagline: With ZKGames you will be able to play most common games with blockchain technology. With ZK technology, now it's possible to play Rock Paper Scissors game on blockchain.
description: Introducing ZKGames, a groundbreaking project that brings the classic, the world's most known game Rock-Paper-Scissors to the decentralized world of blockchain, powered by cutting-edge Mina technology. ZKGames not only provides an entertaining gaming experience but also leverages zero-knowledge proofs (ZKPs) to ensure the utmost security and fairness in gameplay.
how_its_made:
At the core of our project is the timeless game of Rock-Paper-Scissors (RPS), selected for its universal popularity. Employing cutting-edge Zero-Knowledge (ZK) technology, we have seamlessly integrated this classic game into the world of blockchain. ZK technology enables us to validate a player's choice without revealing it, ensuring a secure and confidential gaming experience.

ZKGames offers two exciting options: Player vs. Player (PvP) and Player vs. Computer. Users can make their selections and decisions, followed by placing bets using the desired amount of Mina tokens. In the case of PvP, the second player will choose their move and match the initial player's bet. The computer, in turn, randomly selects its move.

Winners, whether they be players or the computer, will claim the entire prize pool, totaling twice the initial bet. This innovative approach to decentralized gaming not only preserves the thrill of RPS but also incorporates a secure and transparent betting mechanism, promising an engaging experience for participants.
